paragraphs.text: 1. INDRA, whose right hand wields the bolt, we worship, driver of Bay Steeds seeking sundered courses.
paragraphs.original: यजामह इन्द्रं वज्रदक्षिणं हरीणां रथ्यं विव्रतानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yajāmaha indraṃ vajradakṣiṇaṃ harīṇāṃ rathyaṃ vivratānām |

paragraphs.text: Shaking his beard with might he hath arisen, casting his weapons forth and dealing bounties.
paragraphs.original: प्र श्मश्रु दोधुवदूर्ध्वथा भूद्वि सेनाभिर्दयमानो वि राधसा
paragraphs.translit: pra śmaśru dodhuvadūrdhvathā bhūdvi senābhirdayamāno vi rādhasā

paragraphs.text: 2. The treasure which his Bay Steeds found at sacrifice,-this wealth made opulent Indra slayer of the foe.
paragraphs.original: हरी न्वस्य या वने विदे वस्विन्द्रो मघैर्मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ।
paragraphs.translit: harī nvasya yā vane vide vasvindro maghairmaghavā vṛtrahā bhuvat |

paragraphs.text: Rbhu, Rbhuksan, Vaja-he is Lord of Might. The Dasa's very name I utterly destroy.
paragraphs.original: ऋभुर्वाज ऋभुक्षाः पत्यते शवोऽव क्ष्णौमि दासस्य नाम चित्
paragraphs.translit: ṛbhurvāja ṛbhukṣāḥ patyate śavo'va kṣṇaumi dāsasya nāma cit

paragraphs.text: 3. When, with the Princes, Maghavari, famed of old, comes nigh the thunderbolt of gold, and the Controller's car
paragraphs.original: यदा वज्रं हिरण्यमिदथा रथं हरी यमस्य वहतो वि सूरिभिः ।
paragraphs.translit: yadā vajraṃ hiraṇyamidathā rathaṃ harī yamasya vahato vi sūribhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Which his two Tawny Coursers draw, then Indra is the Sovran Lord of power whose glory spreads afar.
paragraphs.original: आ तिष्ठति मघवा सनश्रुत इन्द्रो वाजस्य दीर्घश्रवसस्पतिः
paragraphs.translit: ā tiṣṭhati maghavā sanaśruta indro vājasya dīrghaśravasaspatiḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. With him too is this rain of his that comes like herds: Indra throws drops of moisture on his yellow beard.
paragraphs.original: सो चिन्नु वृष्टिर्यूथ्या स्वा सचाँ इन्द्रः श्मश्रूणि हरिताभि प्रुष्णुते ।
paragraphs.translit: so cinnu vṛṣṭiryūthyā svā sacām̐ indraḥ śmaśrūṇi haritābhi pruṣṇute |

paragraphs.text: When the sweet juice is shed he seeks the pleasant place, and stirs the worshipper as wind disturbs the wood.
paragraphs.original: अव वेति सुक्षयं सुते मधूदिद्धूनोति वातो यथा वनम्
paragraphs.translit: ava veti sukṣayaṃ sute madhūdiddhūnoti vāto yathā vanam

paragraphs.text: 5. We laud and praise his several deeds of valour who, father like, with power hath made us stronger;
paragraphs.original: यो वाचा विवाचो मृध्रवाचः पुरू सहस्राशिवा जघान ।
paragraphs.translit: yo vācā vivāco mṛdhravācaḥ purū sahasrāśivā jaghāna |

paragraphs.text: Who with his voice slew many thousand wicked ones who spake in varied manners with contemptuous cries.
paragraphs.original: तत्तदिदस्य पौंस्यं गृणीमसि पितेव यस्तविषीं वावृधे शवः
paragraphs.translit: tattadidasya pauṃsyaṃ gṛṇīmasi piteva yastaviṣīṃ vāvṛdhe śavaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. Indra, the Vimadas have formed for thee a laud, copious, unparalleled, for thee Most Bountiful.
paragraphs.original: स्तोमं त इन्द्र विमदा अजीजनन्नपूर्व्यं पुरुतमं सुदानवे ।
paragraphs.translit: stomaṃ ta indra vimadā ajījanannapūrvyaṃ purutamaṃ sudānave |

paragraphs.text: We know the good we gain from him the Mighty One when we attract him as a herdsman calls the kine.
paragraphs.original: विद्मा ह्यस्य भोजनमिनस्य यदा पशुं न गोपाः करामहे
paragraphs.translit: vidmā hyasya bhojanaminasya yadā paśuṃ na gopāḥ karāmahe

paragraphs.text: 7. Ne'er may this bond of friendship be dissevered, the Rsi Vimada's and thine, O Indra.
paragraphs.original: माकिर्न एना सख्या वि यौषुस्तव चेन्द्र विमदस्य च ऋषेः ।
paragraphs.translit: mākirna enā sakhyā vi yauṣustava cendra vimadasya ca ṛṣeḥ |

paragraphs.text: We know thou carest for us as a brother with us, O God, be thine auspicious friendship.
paragraphs.original: विद्मा हि ते प्रमतिं देव जामिवदस्मे ते सन्तु सख्या शिवानि
paragraphs.translit: vidmā hi te pramatiṃ deva jāmivadasme te santu sakhyā śivāni
